title: POSTCARDS FROM THE OTHER TOWN · title page
venue: Arthur's site · a romance the strip never ran · eight cards · Box 19
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. One word each.

panels.composition: Left page: a wire postcard spinner outside a coast shop, eight cards in its pockets, every front blank white, the shop's window behind reflecting a bus's side. Right page: the title card's back, divided, the title in souvenir script across the message side in eight pastels, the subtitle the one legible line among strokes, a stamp with no numeral crooked in the corner.
